note: Cases copy the four async_results.rs unit tests (deaf target flagged; every-result-handled, self-transition and call-service controls) plus two deaf results sorted with 'them', a wildcard arm control, a multi-from self-transition control, a multi-from display, and a persist nested in an if at its transition index. Expected findings are the code, path, message and suggestion the Rust validator reports; severity is error.

findings.message: transition browsing--[REFRESH]-->loading declares async result event(s) ["ItemLoaded"] but state 'loading' has no arm handling it — the requester departs before it can hear its own operation's result
findings.suggestion: Add a transition `from: 'loading'` handling each of ["ItemLoaded"] in state 'loading' (or route the result to a state that already does).

findings.message: transition idle--[GO]-->sending starts a call-service whose outcome event(s) ["FAILED"] can arrive while the trait waits in state 'sending', which only async results leave and which has no arm for it, so the outcome is dropped there
findings.suggestion: Add a transition from 'sending' handling each of ["FAILED"], or cancel the call (cancel-call) on the way into 'sending'.
